title: Typhoon Tip Was 1,380 Miles Wide, the Biggest Storm Ever

scenes.text: One storm was nearly half as wide as the United States.
It was Typhoon Tip, over the Pacific in October 1979.
It stretched 1,380 miles across, the biggest tropical storm ever measured.
Gale force winds reached 675 miles from its centre.
Its winds peaked near 190 miles an hour, with one of the lowest pressures ever recorded.
1,380 miles wide. Nothing bigger has ever been measured.

description:
One storm was nearly half as wide as the United States.
Typhoon Tip spanned about 1,380 miles in October 1979, the largest tropical cyclone ever recorded. Gale force winds reached 675 miles from its centre, and its winds peaked near 190 miles an hour.
